title: Khloe Kardashian shouts 'I don't want it' as she reaches four-year celibacy anniversary - NewsBreak
text:
By Scarlett O'Toole ,
29 minutes ago It's safe to say Khloe Kardashian doesn't regret her decision to turn her back on having sex.
The 41-year-old has been open about her desire to focus on her children - True Thompson, seven, and Tatum Thompson, three - after splitting from their dad Tristan Thompson after he cheated on her . The former couple split just seven months before Tatum was born after it was revealed Tristan had fathered a child with another woman.
Khloe has remained single ever since and she opened up about her decision not to see other people on the latest episode of The Kardashians . As Khloe appeared in a confessional, a producer asked, "Are we going on four years now, girl?"
• Kylie Jenner 'doing the heavy lifting' in Timothée Chalamet romance after split rumors
• Kim Kardashian reveals her real name after changing it for reality TV fame
Khloe thought for a moment before replying, "Yes. Four years this December, because Tatum is three, when he was pregnant… Yeah, four years. Cobwebs." The producer then asked, "Do you miss romance?"
Khloe didn't hold back in her response as she shouted, "F--k no!" The Good American founder explained, "I don't think a man or a date or anything is gonna happen anytime soon and I don't, I don't want it to.
"Right now, not worried about if someone’s calling me, texting me. Let me do my thing. You do you. I don't have a you, but like, stay the f--k away from me."
It's not the first time Khloe has spoken about her sex life, or lack of, on her family's reality TV show. During the October 23 episode, Khloe joined her sister Kourtney Kardashian as they discussed Julia Fox's decision to remain celibate.
Khloe then admitted, "I haven't had sex in over three years," as she said she's been busy prioritizing her career, family and friendships. The mom-of-two added, "There's no one I am texting or anyone's phone number."
Khloe dated Tristan on-and-off from 2016 to 2021, when they split for good as a result of his infidelity. Despite the split, Khloe has insisted they still "get along great" and said she tries to keep things friendly for the sake of their kids.
"We get along fine, and for my kids, I will put anything to the side. What’s done is done, so why would I be still holding on to [past drama] for?" she previously said on The Kardashians.
Khloe added, "I don't need to punish him because I am not getting back together with him," before speaking about the boundaries she has in place when it comes to Tristan. "I definitely put my foot down on a lot of things," Khloe admitted.
She explained, "No one is here chilling if there are no kids involved. It is always about the kids and that’s what it is. But we are not hanging out by ourselves."
The Kardashians Season 7 is available to stream on Disney+.
